description: This file implements the server-side logic for the Custom View editing feature in the vtiger CRM application. It handles loading existing custom views, creating new ones, populating filter criteria, managing permissions, and rendering the 'Edit View' template with appropriate data.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Represents the model for custom views, including methods for retrieving and saving view data, filter criteria, and permissions.

methods.name: getByModule_ColumnsHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for selecting columns based on module and columns list.

methods.name: generateSelectColumnsHTML
methods.description: Creates HTML select options for columns, grouped by blocks.

methods.name: getByModule_ColumnsList
methods.description: Retrieves list of columns for a module, formatted for select options, considering existing selections.

methods.name: getStdFilterHTML
methods.description: Builds HTML options for standard filter criteria based on module.

methods.name: getAdvCriteriaHTML
methods.description: Builds HTML options for advanced filter criteria.
